title: Exploration via Activation-Space Steering for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
abstract: arXiv:2610.27012v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) trains a language model by sampling responses, scoring them with an automatic verifier, and updating the policy from the resulting rewards. The policy therefore receives direct learning signals only from trajectories that appear in its rollouts. Yet repeated sampling from the same policy can concentrate on similar reasoning paths, leaving useful alternatives unexplored under a fixed rollout budget. We introduce Activation-Space Exploration (ASE), an online method for diversifying training rollouts. By clustering activation differences between correct and incorrect responses to the same problem, ASE builds a structured bank of latent exploration vectors. Different vectors are then applied to subsequent rollouts to explore alternative reasoning paths. On Qwen3-1.7B-Base and Qwen3-8B-Base trained on DAPO-Math-17k, ASE improves average Mean@8 across six mathematical reasoning benchmarks

translated_title: 基于激活空间引导的可验证奖励强化学习探索方法
translated_abstract: 可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）通过采样模型的响应、使用自动验证器对其评分，并根据所得奖励更新策略来训练语言模型。因此，策略只能从其自身采样生成的轨迹中获得直接学习信号。然而，从同一策略反复采样可能会集中在相似的推理路径上，在固定的采样预算下导致有用的替代路径未被探索。我们提出了激活空间探索（ASE），这是一种用于多样化训练采样的在线方法。通过聚类同一问题正确与错误响应之间的激活差异，ASE 构建了一个结构化的潜在探索向量库。随后，不同的向量被应用于后续的采样过程中，以探索替代的推理路径。在 DAPO-Math-17k 上训练 Qwen3-1.7B-Base 和 Qwen3-8B-Base 时，ASE 在六个数学推理基准上提高了平均 Mean@8 性能。
tldr: 提出激活空间探索（ASE）方法，通过聚类正确与错误响应的激活差异构建潜在探索向量库，并将其应用于训练采样以引导模型探索多样化推理路径，从而提升可验证奖励强化学习在数学推理上的性能。
en_tdlr: ASE diversifies RLVR training rollouts by clustering activation differences between correct and incorrect responses into a bank of exploration vectors that steer subsequent rollouts toward alternative reasoning paths, improving mathematical reasoning performance.
